items.question: Who should participate?
items.answer: Practice owners, practice managers, and front-desk or administrative staff at independent medical practices—especially teams with approximately 2–10 providers. Providers with a perspective on intake and scheduling are welcome, too.

items.question: Is CareIQ already available?
items.answer: CareIQ is currently in development. We’re learning from practice teams before finalizing the product, and we’re not offering a finished product for purchase.

items.question: Is this a sales call?
items.answer: No. It’s a discovery conversation about how your practice works today, what creates extra work, and what would be useful. There’s no purchase obligation.

items.question: Will I need to share patient information?
items.answer: No. Please do not share patient names, records, or other identifying information in the form or the conversation. We’re interested in your processes, not individual patients.

items.question: What happens after I submit the form?
items.answer: Your request is saved so Kristian can follow up by email to coordinate a conversation. Submitting the form does not automatically book an appointment or subscribe you to marketing.

footer.description: A more thoughtful starting point for practice workflows.

privacy.heading: Website privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice covers the CareIQ Labs marketing website and its discovery-interview request form. It does not describe a patient portal or clinical service.

sections.heading: What the form collects
paragraphs: We collect your name, email address, role, and, if you choose to provide it, practice name. A submission reference, the form’s source, the notice version, and the date received are also stored to manage requests and prevent duplicate retries.
Please do not include patient names, records, or other identifying information. We do not ask for phone numbers, files, medical details, or an open-ended message.

sections.heading: Why we use it
paragraphs: Kristian Salmeron uses these details to review your request and follow up by email about a discovery conversation on practice workflows. Submitting the form does not book a meeting or subscribe you to marketing.

sections.heading: How it is handled
paragraphs: The website sends the form to the CareIQ API, which stores the request in a dedicated PostgreSQL table separate from patient and practice records. Authorized operators can review and delete requests using restricted database access.

The deployment uses Render for website and API hosting and the existing CareIQ database infrastructure. These services process information needed to deliver and operate the site. If you correspond with Kristian by email, that conversation is also handled by the email services used to send and receive it.

sections.heading: Browser storage and operational data
paragraphs: This website does not add analytics, advertising pixels, session replay, newsletter tools, or embedded scheduling. The form does not write your details to localStorage or place them in page addresses; it keeps entered values in the current page while you retry.

Hosting and network services may process technical request data, such as IP addresses, timestamps, and browser information. The API uses request information for abuse protection. Its application logging is designed to exclude the contents of this form. This is not a promise that infrastructure produces no logs or cookies.

sections.heading: Retention and your choices
paragraphs: You can choose not to submit the form. You can also ask what contact information we hold about your interview request or ask us to delete it. Interview requests are handled separately from any patient or clinical-record retention policy.

privacy.contactText: Email the address below with your request. Please use the address you submitted where possible so we can identify the request, and do not send patient information.
